prompt: A cinematic film still captures the charged atmosphere of a beach volleyball tournament under the midday sun. In the center, a player in neon green shorts leaps high, arm extended to spike the yellow ball. To the left, a referee in a striped shirt stands on a tall chair, eyes fixed intently on the play. Beside the referee, a woman in a wide-brimmed hat shields her eyes from the glare. On the right side of the net, two defenders in matching blue jerseys crouch low, ready to receive. One defender points sharply toward the spiker while the other looks up at the airborne ball. In the foreground sand, a brown dog lies panting next to a red cooler. A child in a striped swimsuit sits on the cooler, holding a melting ice cream cone. Behind them, a man in a red scarf watches the game with folded arms. Next to him, an elderly woman in a floral dress clutches a white towel. Further back, a vendor in an apron hands a bottle of water to a spectator in sunglasses. The spectator takes the bottle while looking at the court. Near the sideline, a coach in a polo shirt kneels beside a black equipment bag. He gestures toward the players with an open palm. A stray seagull perches on the net post, observing the chaos below. The sand is textured with footprints and scattered shells. There is no snow on the ground. There is no indoor ceiling visible above the scene.
